watch_items.text: Cash flow after leases: FCF after leases fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}} as net capex rose by {{net_capex.change@FY2025}} to {{net_capex@FY2025}}, leaving FCF after leases to debt at {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}}.

Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, and cash and cash-like investments were broadly unchanged at {{cash_like@FY2025}} while debt due within one year fell by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, above the prior year, so refunds on a slower booking environment would absorb more of the cash position.

Profitability: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} is the lowest of the low-cost group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}}) against a peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}, and passenger yield fell by {{passenger_yield.change@FY2025}} to {{passenger_yield@FY2025}}.
